meta.title: Jiti — Translate without stealing focus
meta.description: Jiti is a global-shortcut overlay for translation and grammar. Select text, get a result, stay in the window you were using.

hero.title: Keep your focus.
hero.lead: A system overlay for translation, grammar, and review. One shortcut.

feat.d1: Select text, hit the shortcut, get a translation. Auto direction, swappable engines.
feat.d2: English rewrites with per-error notes. Issues land in your notebook.
feat.d3: Grammar misses are filed automatically. Review them in a separate study window.

how.title: Shortcut down, overlay up
how.lead: The panel is pre-created and stays warm. Show target is under 30 ms.
how.s1d: Translate, grammar, and the unified panel each have a hotkey. Remap in Settings.
how.s2d: macOS uses Accessibility plus a clipboard round-trip, without bumping your frontmost app.
how.s3d: Translation, rewrite, or a mistake card. Esc hides immediately.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: No. Jiti runs locally. Engines use your own key (DeepL, Youdao, or an OpenAI-compatible API).
faq.a2: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10/11. Linux is not in this release.
faq.q3: Why does macOS ask for Accessibility?
faq.a3: Reading selected text in other apps requires it. First launch walks you through; you can still type manually.
faq.a4: On macOS the panel follows a native no-activate path. You can also choose to focus the input on invoke.

foot.title: Install, then select to translate
foot.copy: Jiti is an open-source desktop tool.
